messages:
aj_smith: Kicking off Acme pilot scoping — they want a 2-week eval. Need to align on 2–3 prioritized endpoints, success criteria, and a timeline. Can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

tyler_se: +1. From technical call earlier they emphasized: invoice data extraction, conversational help (chat assist), and customer search rerank. Suggest prioritizing extractor + rerank for the short window.

lisa_sales: Client wants visible latency and cost numbers in the pilot so execs can sign off. Also they asked about data residency (EU) and token logging for compliance.

iris_pm: Proposed success criteria (initial):
- extractor: 90% field extraction accuracy on a 200-doc test set (F1 >= 0.9)
- rerank: NDCG@10 improvement >= 12% vs current ES baseline
- chat assist: average resolution time reduced by 20% in scripted flows
- SLA: p95 latency < 300ms for single-turn small prompts

tyler_se: For endpoints, my minimal POC scope (MVP):
```
POST /v1/pilot/extract -> returns structured invoice fields
POST /v1/pilot/rerank  -> accepts query + candidates, returns ranked ids
POST /v1/pilot/chat    -> chat session with system + user messages
```
We can wire them to a sandbox dataset. Keep extractor first — easier to create evals.

aj_smith: Timeline suggestion:
- Day 0–2: infra + entitlement (EU region + dataset ingest)
- Day 3–6: extractor model onboarding + small eval set
- Day 7: first demo to Acme ops
- Day 8–12: iterate rerank and chat flows
- Day 13–14: final demo + success metric review

oliver_security: @aj_smith @lisa_sales quick heads up on data residency / logging: we can enable EU-only hosting but need customer to sign DPA addendum for shared-hosted. For token logging, we have two modes: "no-persist" (no request/response logs) or "audit-persist" (encrypted logs to KMS). Which does Acme need?

lisa_sales: They prefer no-persist for POC but audit-persist for production. We'll ask them to confirm in the questionnaire.

iris_pm: Minimal success acceptance for this pilot (what we certify as "passed"):
- extractor meets F1 >= 0.9 on their 200-doc set
- rerank shows >= 8% lift in a 100-query blind eval (if we can't hit 12% in 2 weeks)
- deployment is in EU region and token logs are in no-persist mode
- a 20-min exec demo where they validate results against their golden set

tyler_se: Also call out engineering constraints: memory for extractor model ~ 14GB GPU ram (recommend g4dn.xlarge equivalent); batching config for 50–100ms token latency trade-off — we'll default to small batch/low-latency.

aj_smith: Pricing question they raised: can we do a capped pilot spend ($5k) with a toggle to extend?

lisa_sales: Yes, we can set a trial cap. I'll add it to the contract draft.

deploy-bot: deploy started: provisioning-sandbox-eu (id: prov-82) — ETA ~ 18m

tyler_se: Action items:
1) @lisa_sales get DPA sign intent and confirm no-persist for pilot
2) @aj_smith collect 200-doc invoice sample + 100 rerank queries by EOD Thu
3) @tyler_se spin up extractor training + shared eval harness (Day 3 target)
4) @oliver_security validate EU hosting config and KMS options (Day 2)

aj_smith: I'll ping Acme for the sample and runbook. If everyone agrees, I'll schedule Day 7 demo placeholder: Tue 11am CET.

lisa_sales: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

oliver_security: Confirmed EU hosting looks good, will post checklist in #eng-security in 2 hours.

tyler_se: One more note — for evaluation reproducibility, please include golden labels in CSV: id, text, expected_fields (json). Example row:
```
12345, "Invoice text...", "{\"total\": 123.45, \"vendor\": \"Acme Co.\"}"
```

aj_smith: Great. Closing scope for MVP as extractor + rerank, chat is a stretch-goal if time permits. I'll update the pilot brief doc after this thread.

lisa_sales: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and send to Acme with the DPA + spend cap note.
